attchmntText: Burnpur Cement Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Burnpur Cement Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper advertisement of its standalone un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisement was published on 12th November 2026 in Business Standard and Ekdin. Warren Tea Limited reported un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The standalone net profit after tax was 54 lakhs loss for the quarter and 116 lakhs loss for the half year. The consolidated net profit after tax was 54 lakhs loss for the quarter and 116 lakhs loss for the half year. Burnpur Cement Limited reported a standalone net loss after tax of 2231.42 lakhs for the quarter and 4388.03 lakhs for the half year. Titagarh Rail Systems Limited reported un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The standalone net profit after tax was 63.44 lakhs for the quarter and 115.43 lakhs for the half year. The consolidated net profit after tax was 63.20 lakhs for the quarter and 115.78 lakhs for the half year.

attchmntText: Burnpur Cement Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board's Comment on the fine levied by exchanges'.
voiceSummary: Burnpur Cement Limited filed board comments regarding fines imposed by NSE and BSE for non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulation 31A for August 2026. The Board stated the delay was not wilful, as the Company believed an application was only required upon Board approval. The Company submitted the reclassification application after receiving clarification from SEBI. An application for waiver of the penalty was filed. The National Stock Exchange granted a personal hearing on 28th October 2026, represented by Director Mr. Ritesh Aggarwal and Company Secretary Ms. Punam Sharma. The decision on the waiver application is currently awaited.

attchmntText: Burnpur Cement Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Burnpur Cement Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board noted that UV Asset Reconstruction Company Limited transferred debts to CFM Asset Reconstruction Private Limited. The auditor reported that the Company discontinued operations in November 2023 and is not a Going Concern. Cash in hand of Rs. 22.90 lakhs from the Asansol Unit has been idle for over three years. All assets at Patratu were sold, and the Company has no operational units as of 30th September 2026. The Company faces ongoing direct and indirect tax litigations with unascertainable impacts.

attchmntText: Burnpur Cement Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
voiceSummary: Burnpur Cement Limited intimates that on November 10, 2026, it received a letter from UV Asset Reconstruction Company Limited. The letter states that UV Asset Reconstruction Company Limited has reassigned or transferred the debts of Burnpur Cement Limited, along with all underlying securities and associated rights, in favor of CFM Asset Reconstruction Private Limited. The company acknowledges this intimation and will make necessary consequential changes in its records as per the assignment terms and applicable laws. The company will keep the stock exchanges informed of any further material developments regarding this matter.
